title: Ioannes Tzetzes, Historiai (Chiliades) / Book of Histories / Иоанн Цец, «Книга историй» (Хилиады) [RU-gap]
author: John Tzetzes
genre: Verse encyclopedic commentary on his own letters
size: About 12,700 lines (12,674 per ru-wiki; 12,759 per ToposText); about 600–668 historiai.
ru_evidence: Ru-wiki 'Иоанн Цец' lists only excerpts in Памятники византийской литературы IX–XIV вв. (1969), pp. 252–259. No full or substantial translation exists.
en_evidence: Untila, Berkowitz et al. 2015, online at theoi.com under CC BY-NC-ND 3.0, so usable only for cross-checking (ToposText 617).
value: A vast mythographic and historical thesaurus with lost sources and Byzantine scholarly self-portraits, including anecdotes on Alexander. Heavily used but inaccessible to Russian readers.
ai_feasibility: Medium-high. Plain narrative verse that translates readily into prose; source attribution is unreliable, so the commentary must flag errors.
pilot_unit: Book I (est. ~1,000 lines), or a thematic cluster of the Alexander historiai.
